learningObjectives: Explain the core characteristics of a microservices architecture.
Identify communication patterns between independent services.
Design a basic service architecture with separated responsibilities.

activities.title: Monolith vs Microservices
activities.instruction: Explore the structural differences between monolithic and microservices architectures.

content.concept: A monolithic application commonly packages multiple responsibilities into one deployable application, while a microservices architecture separates business capabilities into independently deployable services.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: One deployable application containing multiple business capabilities
Independent services organized around separate business capabilities
Both architectures always require exactly the same deployment structure
Microservices require every service to share the same database schema
config.answer: Independent services organized around separate business capabilities

content.concept: A microservices system can separate business capabilities such as users, orders, payments, and notifications into services with focused responsibilities that communicate through defined interfaces.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

options: One class containing every business responsibility

activities.title: Communication Pattern
activities.instruction: Choose the communication approach that matches the scenario.

content.concept: Services can communicate synchronously through protocols such as HTTP or asynchronously through messaging systems. The appropriate approach depends on timing, coupling, reliability, and workflow requirements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Order Service calls Payment Service over HTTP and waits for the result
Order Service publishes an event and continues without waiting for Payment Service
Both approaches mean the same request-processing behavior
A service must always communicate through direct database access
config.answer: Order Service calls Payment Service over HTTP and waits for the result

activities.title: Service Request Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange a synchronous request across multiple services.

content.concept: A distributed request can travel through several services. Each service performs its responsibility and passes the required result to the next part of the workflow.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
